I replied to Hollis in a thread in #central-team. I couldn't confirm that Gate 34 is the site for the Marlowe rollout at Quarrendon Freight Lines. Nothing in #central-team mentions a site for it, and there are no Quarrendon files in the shared folders.

I told him I'll treat Gate 34 as unconfirmed and keep it out of updates and digests until someone on the account confirms the site in that channel.
